product_one_liner.value: Alice helps enterprises and foundation-model teams secure AI systems using adversarial intelligence, red teaming, and real-time guardrails.
product_one_liner.notes: The company’s current site describes these customer groups and core capabilities.

pricing_page.notes: Homepage navigation/footer has no public pricing page or pricing link; the offer is demo-led.

named_customers.notes: Each name appears among the named case studies; these are customers rather than merely partners.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn company profile lists company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies New York as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Company about page states “Your Trusted Partner (Since 2018).”

eng_blog.notes: A dedicated Engineering @ Alice Medium publication exists. Search results provide multiple engineering/data-infrastructure posts, including the data lake article; the dedicated publication is separate from the marketing blog.

public_docs.notes: Homepage links to public product documentation; docs domain has product documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Current open roles include GenAI Security Researcher, Senior GenAI Safety Researcher, and Principal Data Scientist.

model_provider.value: The product is publicly described as working across OpenAI, Anthropic, Llama, Databricks, and self-hosted models; the company does not identify one exclusive provider.
model_provider.notes: This is its public compatibility statement, not a claim that it relies on one model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The homepage displays SOC 2 Certified and ISO 27001 badges; the LLM page says Alice is SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified.

last_funding.notes: The latest $140 million round was announced August 25, 2026. Available sources do not specify a more precise stage than Series Unknown.

raised_18mo.notes: Alice announced its $140 million funding round on August 25, 2026, within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live postings include Sales Development Representative and GenAI Account Executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Major feature/integration launches during the window include WonderFence on Databricks Unity AI Gateway (Oct. 12, 2026) and guardrails inside LiteLLM (Sep. 29, 2026).

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A Jan. 14, 2026 report says Alice appointed Nurit Cohen Inger and Shahar Tarshish to executive roles within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR posting explicitly asks for hands-on CRM experience and names Salesforce and HubSpot.
